decision: Configured PDM clock is in low-power operating range. Do not claim69dBA high-rate SNR or380uA guaranteed current at actual3.3V from1.8V characterization. Existing0.5mA microphone+clock allocation remains a target.
bench_required: PDM edge rise/fall<=13ns at microphone using current GPIO low-speed setting
Duty cycle40–60% and correct data sampling edge
Supply current at3.3V including MCU clock generation and actual data load
Startup settling, ADF passband/gain and enclosure audio response

sampling_edge_review.evidence: Visually inspected Infineon v1.0 Figure 9 page9. LR=GND drives data after falling edge; data is valid before next rising edge, then goes high impedance after rising edge. Current rising-edge sampling is correct in polarity. ST U5 MDF/ADF training confirms separate rising/falling sampled streams selected by BSMX.
sampling_edge_review.timing_limit: Ideal phase calculation excludes clock propagation, MCU setup/hold, skew, thresholds and load. Not a board timing signoff.
sampling_edge_review.bench_required: Measure CLK/DATA rise/fall, phase and setup/hold at MCU pin.
